decision: Retain schema and vocabulary; replace abstract placement/action/audio application with native implementations.
observed_counterexamples: A supplied actor at1.5,1.5 is overwritten with5.716,5.308.
Straight connectors can pass through a blocked wall.
Three actors in a one-metre rectangle can overlap at0.5,0.5 while authoredFraction reports1.
Social chain0→4→8 can split according to source ordering.
Default six-room dungeon omits release; repeated matching verbs repeat a consequence callback without saved ownership.
An empty or synthetic bridge-only music plan can pass despite having no audio transport. Native audio has no setAdaptivePlan callback.
production_ownership: World, existing controls, native music player and campaign inventory remain authoritative.
